title: Spartan Compat materials
whats_new: Six material recolors for four new 1.21.1 modules: Create, Ars Nouveau, Occultism and AE2. Staged only; modules default to disabled and opt-in uses existing Spartan iron artwork until review.

items.title: Arcane
items.detail: All weapon sprites, including bow states. Original Spartan shading, outlines, grip and binding remain. Left: Spartan iron at 1x. Middle: recolor at 1x. Right: recolor at 4x. Pending art stays outside the jar.

images.caption: Arcane beside vanilla and Spartan iron
